project_info.title: Decision Control Plane: Resilience and Leverage

outline.title: Decision Control Plane: Resilience and Leverage
outline.summary: Executive decision: build a governed, replayable control plane and prove its resilience before scaling.

outline.title: What happens when regions disagree?
outline.summary: The core failure mode is not downtime alone; it is dual authority, duplicate action, and unverifiable history.

outline.title: The active-active failover protocol
outline.summary: Show normal service, partition, fencing, takeover, and heal/reconcile with ownership epochs and idempotent actions.

outline.title: Simulation results: safe degradation worked
outline.summary: Show continuous partition-injection results and key safety outcomes from the deterministic harness.

outline.title: Operational runbook: who does what
outline.summary: Summarize tenant migration, key rotation, partition response, and recurring DR drill responsibilities.

outline.title: Production gates before scale
outline.summary: Define the hard validation gates: no split brain, no duplicate actions, RPO behavior, replay, isolation, and RTO.

outline.title: How to leverage the work
outline.summary: Turn the research into a 90-day lighthouse, reusable kernel, adapter SDK, assurance suite, and second-domain expansion.

outline.title: The executive decision
outline.summary: Fund proof now, scale only after measured evidence, and keep the kernel stable while domains remain pluggable.
